name: payback-coupon-activator
description: Activates every pending coupon in your PAYBACK account once or several times a day, using headless Chromium and the cookies of a browser session you export yourself. It never types your password and never solves or bypasses bot checks. When a person is needed, it stops and notifies you (Pushover, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, ... via shoutrrr). **Setup** 1. Log in at payback.de in your desktop browser. 2. Export the cookies with the "Cookie-Editor" extension (Export - JSON). 3. Save them as cookies.json in the data folder of this container. The cookie file grants full access to your PAYBACK account. Treat it like a password. Without it the container keeps running and reports "session expired". **Notifications** There is no web interface; the status is in the container log. You get a notification when the session expires, a bot check appears, the page layout changed or coupons could not be activated. **Disclaimer** Unofficial project, not affiliated with PAYBACK GmbH. It drives the payback.de website, which can change at any time. Use at your own risk and check PAYBACK's terms of use.

paths.name: Data folder (cookies.json)
paths.description: Holds cookies.json. Refreshed cookies are written back to this file after successful runs.

variables.name: Run time(s) (RUN_AT)
variables.description: Daily run time as HH:MM (24h). Several times separated by commas, e.g. 04:00,12:00,19:00. DST-aware.

variables.name: Notification URL (NOTIFY_URL)
variables.description: shoutrrr URL, e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/YOUR_TOPIC, pushover://shoutrrr:APP_TOKEN@USER_KEY or telegram://BOT_TOKEN@telegram?chats=CHAT_ID. Empty disables notifications.

variables.name: Notify on success too
variables.description: true also notifies after successful runs; default reports problems only.

variables.name: Run once on start
variables.description: true runs one cycle right after the container starts.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: Time zone used for the run times.

variables.name: Browser user agent
variables.description: User-Agent of the browser the cookies came from (Firefox: about:support, Chrome: chrome://version). Helps when the session is bound to that browser.

variables.name: Cookie file inside container
variables.description: Path of the cookie file inside the container.
